current_write_state: Writes continue through the task-authorized live writer; no quiesce has been approved.
consistency_gate: Obtain database-owner approval for either a coordinated write freeze plus checkpoint or an application-consistent SQLite backup API export before invoking Restic.
required_restore_validation: Restore one exact full snapshot ID into a new isolated directory.
Run SQLite integrity_check on the restored database.
Verify identities, roles, identity_roles, and the approved change-log high-water mark.
Confirm repository check succeeds and the source remains untouched.
